thread:
maria_cs: Heads up — NetFjord renewal hit a snag with DocuSign routing + tax/VAT entity mismatch. Need alignment before EOD to avoid onboarding delay.

jordan_ae: Quick context: customer agreed to 12m renewal (+8%) for 250 seats. Procurement sent PO but vendor code doesn't match the billing entity on the contract. They also requested Net60. PO#: 456789-PS.

sarah_legal: Net60 is ok in principle but needs finance/SAM approval. Also NetFjord's procurement wants invoices to be issued to their EU subsidiary (NetFjord NL B.V.). Do we have legal entity & VAT setup for NL invoicing? If not, withholding/tax might apply.

devin_ops: Onboarding timeline: we planned kickstart next Monday. If signatures slip >72h we lose the next cohort slot. CC payment would speed things but procurement won't accept. Any workaround?

jordan_ae: Procurement won't sign without vendor code match and their AP team needs the PO to exactly match vendor name on invoice. They say "no PO, no go".

docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope 0x8f3a - status: sent. Recipients: procurement@netfjord.com (needs to sign), legal@netfjord.nl (cc). Envelope link: https://docusign.example/envelopes/0x8f3a

maria_cs: Two issues to resolve: vendor code + billing entity. Proposal A: invoice US entity (faster) and set up cross-charge paperwork offline — requires procurement ok. Proposal B: we route DocuSign to their NL approver and finance issues EUR invoice (slower). Which has lower churn?

finance_ryan: We can invoice NL entity but we need their VAT reg number and vendor code 9988 in our system. If they provide VAT docs today we can issue EUR invoice next week. If not, US invoicing is possible but we'll need a billing amendment and they'll need to accept currency conversion + possible withholding.

sarah_legal: If we go with US invoicing we should add a short Delegated Billing Addendum allowing them to provide PO that references our US entity. I'll draft a one-paragraph amendment.

jordan_ae: Customer asked if we can shorten to 9m at current price to avoid procurement escalation and get them onboard sooner — they'd accept a shorter term to keep seat count. Is that something CS + RevOps will entertain as a concession?

maria_cs: I'm fine offering a one-time 9m bridge at the quoted unit price to preserve onboarding cadence, if finance confirms revenue recognition is acceptable. This avoids the PO holdup.

finance_ryan: 9m term at current price is acceptable if we record a note for ARR forecasting. Need AE to tag the renewal in the CRM as "bridge-term-9m" and add the PO number when provided.

sarah_legal: I'll prep the Delegated Billing Addendum and a clause for Net60 payment terms conditioned on the invoice being issued to the NL entity + VAT documentation.

devin_ops: Operational ask: if we go 9m bridge, please confirm: 1) kickstart still Monday? 2) will they get onboarding credits pro-rated? I need to update the kickoff invitees.

jordan_ae: 1) yes if signatures by EOD tomorrow. 2) we'll prorate onboarding credits for 9m. I'll update the order form.

maria_cs: Action items: @jordan_ae confirm with procurement that US-invoice fallback is acceptable (PO will reference US entity) OR get VAT docs for NL today; @finance_ryan register vendor code 9988 if NL is confirmed; @sarah_legal draft Delegated Billing Addendum + Net60 conditional clause; @devin_ops hold kickoff slot but tentatively inform CS Leads of possible shift. I will follow up in 2 hours with status. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

docsign-bot: Reminder: envelope 0x8f3a will auto-expire in 72 hours.

jordan_ae: Update — procurement said they can accept US invoice if we add "Bill To: NetFjord Inc (AP Team)" on invoice and PO will be reissued. They're routing docs internally now.

maria_cs: Great — finance/legal can we go ahead with Delegated Billing Addendum and US invoicing fallback? If yes, I'll approve sending the updated envelope and we can keep kickoff Monday.

sarah_legal: Yes — I'll post the addendum in the thread in 30m, will include a short sign-off for procurement to allow PO to reference the US entity.

finance_ryan: Registering vendor code 9988 as a precaution. We can proceed with US invoice fallback and mark for cross-charge if NL VAT later provided.

maria_cs: Thanks all — I'll update the customer and re-send DocuSign once addendum is attached.

(ends)
